title: Engineering Reliable Coding Agents: Evaluating and Operating the System Around the Model
abstract: arXiv:2608.13867v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI coding agents are commonly evaluated as models but deployed as systems. Their reliability depends not only on model capability, but on the harness, execution state, retrieval, memory and state management, permissions, review interfaces, and resource allocation. This monograph examines those boundaries and develops a framework for evaluating and operating coding agents reliably. It synthesizes 164 scholarly works, 100 practitioner records, 29 benchmark records, and 17 author-system case records through a structured multivocal review, targeted update audits, software-engineering coverage analysis, and distributed-systems evidence synthesis. Across this evidence, many apparent model failures originate elsewhere in the system, while improvements at one layer often fail to propagate to end-to-end outcomes. translated_title: 构建可靠的编码代理：评估并操作系统围绕模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13867v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：AI编码代理通常被当作模型进行评估，但作为系统进行部署。它们的可靠性不仅取决于模型能力，还取决于支架（harness）、执行状态、检索、记忆与状态管理、权限、审查接口和资源分配。本专著考察了这些边界，并开发了一个框架，用于可靠地评估和操作编码代理。它通过结构化的多声部审查、有针对性的更新审计、软件工程覆盖分析和分布式系统证据综合，综合了164篇学术著作、100份实践者记录、29份基准记录和17份作者-系统案例记录。在这些证据中，许多明显的模型失败源于系统的其他部分，而某一层的改进往往无法传导到端到端的结果。评估和操作被视为一个依赖链，其中任务构建、执行环境、检索等方面的弱点会影响整体性能。
tldr: 本文通过综合大量文献和案例，提出编码代理的可靠性取决于整个系统而非仅模型本身，并建立了一个评估和操作框架，强调系统各层间的依赖关系。
en_tdlr: This monograph synthesizes extensive evidence to show that coding agent reliability depends on the entire system, not just the model, and proposes a framework for evaluation and operation that emphasizes dependency chains across system layers.
